name: cursor-rewrite-progress
description: A progress bar and spinner rewriting in place with carriage returns, save/restore cursor, and absolute cursor addressing.

command:
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  printf '\r[%-20s] %3d%%' "$(printf '#%.0s' $(seq 1 $((i/2+1))))" "$((i*100/40))"
done
printf '\n'
printf '\033[s'
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  printf '\033[u\033[Kspinner %s step %02d' "$(printf '%s' '|/-\' | cut -c$(( i % 4 + 1 )))" "$i"
done
printf '\n'
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  printf '\033[%d;1Hrow %02d rewritten' "$((i % 10 + 5))" "$i"
done
printf '\033[20;1H\n'
